je_test_doc: Test to verify the filter is actually passed to feeder and is running at feeder.
notes: N/A: pluggable feeder filters (setFeederFilter + filter serialized to and run at the feeder, dropping records) are not implemented in Noxu; the whole block-filter -> ReplicaConsistencyException path has no analogue. Documented deviation.

je_test_doc: Test that uses a filter pass everything, so the rep group is expected to be created normally.
notes: no-op/pass-all filter == Noxu's always-pass-all baseline; a 3-node group forms and every VLSN reaches every replica. Faithful equivalent of testNoOpFilter.

je_test_doc: Test that uses a filter pass everything, and also tracks the statistics which are used for verification.
notes: N/A: filter-statistics tracking depends on the unimplemented feeder filter. The portable half (no entry silently dropped under replication) is covered by feeder_no_silent_drops_under_replication.

je_test_doc: Check that we can retrieve the correct results when doing forward scans.
notes: forward VLSN scan over a real log returns replicated entries in order, skips non-replicated; plus stream-level fan-out.

je_test_doc: Check that we can wait for an upcoming VLSN when doing forward scans.
notes: scanner returns None at end-of-log (JE: times out and waits) then picks up an entry written afterward; no error, no jump to a nonexistent file.

je_test_doc: Check that we can retrieve the correct results when doing backwards scans.
notes: backward sync-point walk (prev_sync_candidate stops only at is_sync entries) proven against real log sync flags.

je_test_doc: Check that we can find the sync-able matchpoints when doing backward scans.
notes: findPrevSyncEntry == prev_sync_candidate; matchpoint search stops at syncable entries only; catch-up resumes at matchpoint+1.

je_test_doc: Test that a feeder reader can read log entries that have not yet been flushed to disk.
notes: N/A: JE FeederReader reads entries still in the log buffer before they are flushed to disk. Noxu's feeder read path (EnvironmentLogScanner) scans on-disk data only (blocking-I/O core, no feeder log-buffer fetch). Documented deviation.

je_test_doc: Test that a feeder reader can switch between reading from the log buffer pool, to the file, to the logBuffer pool, and back and forth.
notes: N/A: JE FeederReader$SwitchWindow buffer<->file<->buffer switching mechanics. Noxu has no offset-window reader; nothing to switch. Documented deviation.

je_test_doc: [#18882] Before this bug fix, this test would result in a java.io.FileNotFoundException out of FeederReader$SwitchWindow.fillNext.
notes: write-queue FIFO / no-drop invariant (the load-bearing half of [#18882]); the specific SwitchWindow file-transition bug is N/A (no offset-window reader).
encode->decode->match round-trip over every ProtocolMessage variant + the syncup message set. Deviation: no multi-version/SNTP/JEVersions/GroupAck/ReAuthenticate messages.
N/A: Noxu has no multi-version wire protocol / version negotiation (single protocol). Documented deviation.

je_test_doc: Test that writing a message containing a log entry where the requested log format version is less than both the current log version and the log entry version results in converting the entry to the req
notes: N/A: no cross-version log-entry conversion on write; single .ndb LOG_VERSION=3. Documented deviation.

je_test_doc: Test that writing a message containing a log entry where the requested log format version is less than the current log version but is compatible with the requested version results in the entry being c
notes: N/A: same as testWritePreviousVersionOlderConvert (no cross-version entry copy/convert path). Documented deviation.

je_test_doc: Test reading a NodeGroupInfo object using the format that does not support the jeVersion field.
notes: N/A: no JEVersion field / protocol-version-4 NodeGroupInfo format. Documented deviation.

je_test_doc: Test sending a SECONDARY node to a master running a protocol version that does not support them.
notes: N/A: no protocol-version negotiation, so no 'secondary to old master' rejection path. Documented deviation.
end-to-end scan of a real log: only replicated commits counted, passed-ckpt-end noted, earliest passed txn recorded.
